sentences.text:
The present petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking quashing of order dated 11.04.2009
(Annexure P-3) passed by the COUrt of Judicial Magistrate Ist Class Patti District Tarn Taran
wherein the petitioner was declared as proclaimed offender in criminal case having Fir No.70 dated
23.08.2008 under Section 420/467/468/471/120 of Ipc, Police Station Harike, District Tarn Taran
(Annexure P-1).
2. Counsel for the petitioner inter alia

submits that at the relevant time when the alleged occurrence took place and when the proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. were initiated against the petitioner,
he was not available in India and was away to USA.

It is further submitted that no notice/summon/warrants issued by the Court concerned were received by the petitioner through Baljinder Singh @ Billa vs State Of Punjab on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48488675/
1 Indian Embassy in USA with regard to pendency of the aforesaid criminal case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner further submits that 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:051090 CRM-M-42182-2023 [2] 2024:PHHC:051090 now the matter has been compromise between the parties and FIR Annexure P-1 has been quashed by this Court vide order of even date.
3. The State counsel has not refuted the fact that FIR Annexure P-1 is already quashed by this Court.
4. Admittedly, impugned order Annexure P-3 is offshoot of FIR Annexure P-1 which is already quashed by this Court.

Even otherwise, it appears that the impugned order is not passed in consonance with the mandate of Section 82 Cr.P.C.
5.
For the forgoing reasons, the present petition is allowed and impugned order Annexure P-3 is hereby set aside.
